    try:
        import pyaudio
    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("pyaudio is required for microphone streaming") from exc

    sample_rate = 16000
    chunk_size = int(sample_rate / 10)
    audio_format = pyaudio.paInt16
    channels = 1

    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = pa.open(
        format=audio_format,
        channels=channels,
        rate=sample_rate,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=chunk_size,
    )

    async def generator() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        start = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        try:
            while True:
                if record_seconds > 0 and (asyncio.get_event_loop().time() - start) >= record_seconds:
                    break
                data = await asyncio.to_thread(stream.read, chunk_size, False)
                yield data
        finally:
            stream.stop_stream()
            stream.close()
            pa.terminate()

    return generator()

        interim_results=True,
        single_utterance=False,
    )

    if isinstance(value, bool):

    if confidence is None and isinstance(event.get("alternative"), dict):
        confidence = event["alternative"].get("confidence")
    try:
        confidence = None if confidence is None else float(confidence)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        confidence = None
